did: Traced why the S21 stopped reading home after a new APK. The owner had reinstalled the app: Android's backup brought back the phone's storage but not the pairing, so pairing again made a new pairing id and the phone forgot everything it knew home held. Every section then re-sent all it had ever kept, aph's history waited behind that, and Rust Rounds week 46 said Saturday's send never reached home, though home holds it as final. The fixes: the phone now catches up by itself after home restarts to update, and a closed week says what counted from home's own record (#3281); aph reads home's history as its screens open, beside the sending (#3285); and pairing again with the same home and account keeps what the phone knew home held (#3292), with a server change the coordinator carries. The interview week now reads its closed week from home's record too, through the same helper Rust Rounds uses (#3297).

calls.title: A 502 or 504 from home's front door is held as home not answering, and tried again on the away hold
options: hold it as a silence under the away hold, and ask again whether home serves this build when home answers
have home's compat answer say when to ask again, a server change
leave it to the app coming back to the front or a pull
calls.why: The away hold is the one bounded way the phone already tries again on its own, and no timer of its own is added.
calls.undo: Drop the door branch in the link's request handling and the serves back ask (C750).

calls.title: Pairing again with the same home and account keeps what the phone knows home holds
options: keep it, the account named by a random per-account id home answers at pairing
keep it, the account named by a salted hash of the account's id
keep it across any pairing to the same home address
leave every pairing to start fresh
calls.why: A reinstall restores the memory but not the pairing, and re-sending everything stalls every screen for hours; a random id follows the phone id's own rule.
calls.undo: Drop the scope branch of readSent and the account read at pairing (C751).

left: The server half of the pairing scope is with the coordinator as a patch, to land after #3292; until it does, pairing again still starts the memory fresh.
A closed week's read of home's record, in Rust Rounds and the interview week, can be overwritten by an older opening's late answer; a per-opening token in both runtimes would end it.
Jobs on the S21 showed Nov 15's picks on Nov 19; not traced here.
